生成查询代码
SELECT 
    t.FUND_NAME AS `基金简称`,
    t.FUND_SYMBOL AS `基金代码`,
    t.REPORT_DATE AS `报告期`,
    ROUND(t.NET_VALUE/100000000, 2) AS `资产净值(亿元)`
FROM 
    FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION t
WHERE 
    t.FUND_NAME LIKE '%易方达蓝筹精选混合%'
    AND t.REPORT_DATE = (
        SELECT 
            MAX(REPORT_DATE) 
        FROM 
            FUND_ASSET_ALLOCATION 
        WHERE 
            FUND_NAME LIKE '%易方达蓝筹精选混合%'
            AND HISVALID=1
    )
    AND t.HISVALID = 1
LIMIT 1
